description: Marks one conversation Resolved, as the Resolved button in the Cosend Inbox does. Nothing is sent to anyone and no automation starts. Afterwards no person holds the conversation (the person, the assignee, the priority and any hand-over are cleared) and every automation on that WhatsApp number treats the customer’s next message as a first message: the welcome menu greets again, an unfinished question flow starts over, and the AI assistant begins a new AI conversation, which counts as one more AI conversation on the plan. The message history stays. It does not hand the chat to the assistant or reply to the customer. It is refused for a credential with no person behind it.
